Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sunita - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Naira - 10 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Sharda - 71 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Vihaan - 8 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "What lovely weather!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Sunita (gently): "Okay, Nikhil."

[Flower petals rain down on Nikhil.]

Sunita: "Good job, Nikhil!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Nikhil (excited): "Okay, Mom."

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Naira stand near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Nikhil (excited): "One more time!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Nikhil: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Nikhil: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil knocks on the door.]

Naira (excited): "And then?"

[Nikhil opens the door and goes out.]

Nikhil (laughing): "One more time!"

[Nikhil slams the door shut.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[Nikhil opens the window.]

Sharda (surprised): "That was such a fun day!"
